solve_tril_compute_inverse: compute the inverse of the matrix I + A where A is strictly lower triangular using a Triton kernel
solve_tril_varlen_support: compute lower-triangular matrix inverse with variable-length sequences using cu_seqlens and chunk_indices
solve_tril_16x16_block: run the 16x16 block Triton kernel to compute inverse of strictly lower triangular matrix chunks
solve_tril_merge_32x32: merge two 16x16 blocks into a 32x32 inverse using block-wise triangular solve with off-diagonal dot products
solve_tril_merge_64x64: merge four 16x16 blocks into a 64x64 inverse using recursive block-wise triangular solve with off-diagonal dot products
